messages:
ellie: Quick check — planning to flip the `sr_v2_compat` flag to `on` for a gradual canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. This enables the new structured-response / function-call output shape (note: payload keys change). Need to confirm client SDK fallback behaviour, telemetry, and rollback signals. Short plan: 10% internal dev traffic -> 5% beta customers -> 25% general. Anyone blocking?

sam: Two quick q's: 1) Old SDKs (<=1.4) will still see plain text responses, right? We had an opt-out shim before. 2) Do we set a compat header or rely on `client-sdk-compat` flag? :eyes:

ellie: Good call. For backward compat we’ll keep the `sr_shim` enabled by default for SDKs <1.5. New SDKs get structured responses unless `client-sdk-compat=false`. So toggle surface: `sr_v2_compat` (server), plus `client-sdk-compat` (client opt-in gate).

kevin: Telemetry checklist I want in place before 09:00 PT: `sr.error_rate`, `sr.latency_p50/p95`, `sr.malformed_outputs` (schema validation failures), and `sr.regressions.token_delta` (diff vs. baseline). Also enable a dashboard alert for `sr.malformed_outputs > 0.5%` and auto-roll to previous model on spike.

maya: For the canary audiences: suggest we do 50% internal devs (incidents, infra, platform), 5% invited beta orgs (list in rollout doc), and 5% random customers, not 25% straightaway. We should also have a follow-up post-canary QA checklist (prompt set sanity, function routing tests, and SDK acceptance tests). I can curate the prompts and run evals after the first hour.

ellie: Updated plan based on feedback:
- T+0 (09:00 PT): enable `sr_v2_compat=true` for 10% internal dev traffic (controlled by targeting rule `audience:internal-sr-canary`). Keep `sr_shim=true` for SDKs <1.5.
- T+1h: if telemetry green, expand to 5% beta orgs (`audience:beta-sr`) and 5% random customers.
- T+6h: if still green, pause and run prompt-evals. If pass, scale to 25% progressive with 1h holds per step.
- Rollback: instant flip `sr_v2_compat=false`; auto-fallback policy to previous model variant if `sr.malformed_outputs` alert fires.

Config snippet for ops/infra doc:```yaml
feature_flags:
  sr_v2_compat: true
  client-sdk-compat: true
  sr_shim: true  # legacy payload shim for <1.5 SDK
canary:
  - audience: internal-sr-canary
    pct: 10
  - audience: beta-sr
    pct: 5
  - audience: random-prod-sr
    pct: 5
alerts:
  sr_malformed_threshold: 0.5
```

sam: Thanks — for SDK behaviour I’ll add a small change to the JS SDK to opt-out by header `x-sr-compat: 1.4` so we don't rely on old version detection alone. Will open PR and ping for review.

kevin: CI/QA ask: can we run `sr-schema-check` across the canary logs and surface top 10 mismatches? I can wire that to the dashboard. Also add `:white_check_mark:`/`:rotating_light:` quick actions to the alert runbook for manual rollback vs emergency rollback.

ci-bot: sr-schema-check (pre-canary run) completed — 0 schema errors on staging, full-tests passed (218/218). See CI job: https://ci.redwood/sr-schema/4721

maya: I'll start curating prompts and add the prompt set to the rollout doc. Also tagging @support to prep a short notice for beta customers if we expand.

ellie: Perfect — next steps: @sam open SDK PR, @kevin wire the dashboard alerts, @maya publish the eval set by 08:00 PT tomorrow. If no objections by EOD today I’ll schedule the flag flip. :thumbsup:
